purpose: Resolve a Pennsylvania business to one strong registry entity and compare its source-published registered county with a caller-supplied allowed county set.

allowedCounties.description: Comma-separated Pennsylvania county names, e.g. Schuylkill,Dauphin

decision_policy.policy_match: A unique strong PA registry entity was found and its registered county is in allowedCounties.
decision_policy.policy_mismatch: A unique strong PA registry entity was found and its registered county is not in allowedCounties.
decision_policy.company_not_found: No Pennsylvania registry entity candidate was found.
decision_policy.human_review: Registry evidence is unavailable, ambiguous, incomplete, or the registry county is missing.

claim_boundaries: policy_match evaluates only the source-published registered county against the caller's allowed list
it does not prove physical operations, headquarters location, service area, residency, local ownership, tax situs, good standing, authority, or legal compliance
